verdict: All three sides captain Haaland. He is the season cum_pts leader, the locked APEX rule, and intel's captain shield at about 140% EO. That gives HIGH conviction. Scored on the same xpts.json scale, CLAUDE ranks first at 95.06, GEMINI second at 93.88 (its own figure of 67.49 is on a different scale), and YOU last at 89.12. YOUR current team does not match the best plan. It needs one transfer and a reshuffle of the XI. The engines DISAGREE on the transfer target. Gemini's Dasilva->Konsa is unreliable on two counts: the injury reason is a name collision (our Dasilva is the fit COV DEF), and Konsa's ARS tag and 12.87 xpts are suspect because he plays for AVL and his GW5 minutes share was 0.53. Gemini's XI also starts Belloumi (FDR 5) over Hall and Manzambi. Claude's Dasilva->Vuskovic is the cleaner move: he is nailed (797/810 mins), it adds no 4th BOU player, and he is a 7.4% EO differential in form. Claude also starts Vuskovic and Isak in place of Manzambi (rotation gate, about 43 mins per GW) and Belloumi (HUL, FDR 5).
